raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Fixes the torch log-prob path (`logprobs_from_logits_naive` and `logprobs_from_logits_v2`) so a confident label keeps its logprob and gradient. Before this change both rounded to exactly 0 once the label's margin over the other logits passed ~16.6 in fp32 (~5.5 for v2's bf16 branch on CPU), while the other logits kept nonzero gradients. Part of #8376, which has a repro; the Triton fused-kernel half is #8378.

Following Barron et al., "A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy" (arXiv:2610.31642), the label logprob is computed as `logp_t = -softplus(logsumexp_{j != t}(z_j) - z_t)`, with the label left out of the logsumexp.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Query links: [`logprobs_from_logits`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+logprobs_from_logits), [`cross entropy precision`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+cross+entropy+precision), [`log_softmax confident`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+log_softmax+confident)
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

**Why this does not duplicate an existing PR:** I searched open PRs and issues (the queries above, plus `logprobs softplus`, `softmax underflow`, `expm1`), and none changes how the label logprob is computed. Three open PRs touch the same file for other reasons, so whichever lands second will need a rebase:
- #3852 restructures `logprobs_from_logits_naive` for speed (compiled implementation).
- #8026 adds an opt-in batch-invariant mode using fp32 `log_softmax` plus gather.
- #6110 adds per-sample temperature.

### Test

AI-assisted change, see the statement at the end. Run on an RTX 3090 with torch 2.9.1+cu128:

```bash
pytest tests/utils/test_torch_functional_logprobs_on_cpu.py tests/utils/test_torch_functional.py -q
# 25 passed, 4 failed
```

- The 4 failures are `test_distributed_mean_max_min_std[2|4]` and `test_distributed_masked_mean[2|4]`. They need 2 or 4 GPUs (`CUDA error: invalid device ordinal` on my single GPU), and this PR doesn't change that file.
- **New file `tests/utils/test_torch_functional_logprobs_on_cpu.py`** (14 tests, picked up by `cpu_unit_tests.yml`), each run for both functions:
  - Parity with `log_softmax` plus gather, values and gradients, for fp32, bf16, and fp64.
  - Confident labels (fp32 margins of ~23–73, bf16 margins of ~6–23) against an fp64 reference, including the label gradient balancing the others.
  - A label with no finite competitor gets logprob 0 and finite (zero) gradients.
  - A `-inf` label, and one at -1e8 among logits near 0, get the gradient `onehot - softmax`, and a zero gradient when masked out of the loss.
  - The confident-label tests fail on `main` and pass here.
- **CUDA** (logits `[1024, 32000]`, against an exact fp64 reference), for both functions:
  - Confident labels: the fp32 logprob's relative error goes from 1.0 (rounded to 0) to 1.1e-6.
  - Ordinary labels: the fp32 gradient's relative error is 3.8e-6, vs 4.0e-6 on `main`. In bf16 the other logits' gradient error drops from 1.4e-1 to 7.6e-3, since the computation now runs in fp32.
- **Issue repro** before and after:
  ```
  main: logprobs_from_logits_naive: logprob=0.000e+00 label_grad=0.000e+00 other_grads_sum=-2.994e-09
  this: logprobs_from_logits_naive: logprob=-2.994e-09 label_grad=2.994e-09 other_grads_sum=-2.994e-09
  ```
  v2 gives the same numbers.
- **Memory** (CUDA, logits `[4, 1024, 32000]`, forward then backward):

  | | retained between fwd and bwd, `main` → this PR | fwd+bwd peak, `main` → this PR |
  |---|---|---|
  | v2 fp32 | 0 → 0 | 0.98 → 0.98 GiB |
  | v2 bf16 | 0.24 → 0 GiB | 0.49 → 0.49 GiB |
  | naive fp32 | 0.49 → 0 GiB | 1.46 → 0.98 GiB |
  | naive bf16 | 0.24 → 0 GiB | 0.73 → 0.98 GiB |

  naive bf16 now upcasts to fp32 inside the forward, so its peak rises. Nothing is kept between forward and backward for any path.
- `pre-commit run` on the changed files passes.

### API and Usage Example

No API changes. Results match `log_softmax` at ordinary margins, and differ from `main` only where `main` had rounded to 0. bf16 inputs are now computed in fp32 and cast back to bf16.

### Design & Code Changes

- New `_LabelLogprobs` `autograd.Function` in `verl/utils/torch_functional.py`:
  - **Forward:** gathers the label logit, then takes the logsumexp of a copy of the logits with the label set to `-inf`, in at least fp32. It saves the full `logsumexp(z) = logaddexp(logsumexp_{j != t}(z_j), z_t)` for backward. Rebuilding it as `z_t - logp_t` would give NaN for a `-inf` label.
  - **Backward:** recomputes `p_j = exp(z_j - logsumexp(z))` from the saved input. It returns `-p_j` for the other logits and `1 - p_t = -expm1(logp_t)` at the label. Only the input logits and per-label values are saved. Backward is `once_differentiable`: second derivatives through it aren't supported.
- `logprobs_from_logits_naive` calls it on the full logits. `logprobs_from_logits_v2` keeps its row loop and calls it per row, and its separate bf16 `log_softmax` branch is gone.
- Not touched: the flash-attn and NPU cross-entropy dispatch in `logprobs_from_logits`. On CUDA with flash-attn installed, those still serve the default path; see #8376.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting)
- [ ] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs). Not needed: no user-facing change beyond the numerics.
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code.
- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in the `ci-request` channel.
- [ ] If your PR is related to the `recipe` submodule, please also update the reference to the submodule commit. N/A

**AI assistance:** this change was written with AI assistance (Claude Code). The tests and measurements above were run locally as listed.

** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Recompute the normalization value from the logits.** When the selected logit is `-inf` and another logit is finite, `label_logits - label_logprobs` evaluates to `-inf - (-inf)`, so backward produces NaN competitor gradients. With float32 logits `[-1e8, 0, 1]` and label `0`, cancellation instead reconstructs `0` and produces competitor gradients of `-1` and `-e`, rather than normalized probabilities. Compute the normalization with `torch.logsumexp` on the logits in backward.

+

+        grad_logits = logits.to(label_logprobs.dtype, copy=True).sub_(logsumexp.unsqueeze(-1)).exp_()

Following Barron et al., "A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy" (arXiv:2610.31642), the label logprob is computed as `logp_t = -softplus(logsumexp_{j != t}(z_j) - z_t)`, with the label left out of the logsumexp.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Query links: [`logprobs_from_logits`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+logprobs_from_logits), [`cross entropy precision`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+cross+entropy+precision), [`log_softmax confident`](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+log_softmax+confident)
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

**Why this does not duplicate an existing PR:** I searched open PRs and issues (the queries above, plus `logprobs softplus`, `softmax underflow`, `expm1`), and none changes how the label logprob is computed. Three open PRs touch the same file for other reasons, so whichever lands second will need a rebase:
- #3852 restructures `logprobs_from_logits_naive` for speed (compiled implementation).
- #8026 adds an opt-in batch-invariant mode using fp32 `log_softmax` plus gather.
- #6110 adds per-sample temperature.

AI-assisted change, see the statement at the end. Run on an RTX 3090 with torch 2.9.1+cu128:

```bash
pytest tests/utils/test_torch_functional_logprobs_on_cpu.py tests/utils/test_torch_functional.py -q
# 25 passed, 4 failed
```

- The 4 failures are `test_distributed_mean_max_min_std[2|4]` and `test_distributed_masked_mean[2|4]`. They need 2 or 4 GPUs (`CUDA error: invalid device ordinal` on my single GPU), and this PR doesn't change that file.
- **New file `tests/utils/test_torch_functional_logprobs_on_cpu.py`** (14 tests, picked up by `cpu_unit_tests.yml`), each run for both functions:
  - Parity with `log_softmax` plus gather, values and gradients, for fp32, bf16, and fp64.
  - Confident labels (fp32 margins of ~23–73, bf16 margins of ~6–23) against an fp64 reference, including the label gradient balancing the others.
  - A label with no finite competitor gets logprob 0 and finite (zero) gradients.
  - A `-inf` label, and one at -1e8 among logits near 0, get the gradient `onehot - softmax`, and a zero gradient when masked out of the loss.
  - The confident-label tests fail on `main` and pass here.
- **CUDA** (logits `[1024, 32000]`, against an exact fp64 reference), for both functions:
  - Confident labels: the fp32 logprob's relative error goes from 1.0 (rounded to 0) to 1.1e-6.
  - Ordinary labels: the fp32 gradient's relative error is 3.8e-6, vs 4.0e-6 on `main`. In bf16 the other logits' gradient error drops from 1.4e-1 to 7.6e-3, since the computation now runs in fp32.
- **Issue repro** before and after:
  ```
  main: logprobs_from_logits_naive: logprob=0.000e+00 label_grad=0.000e+00 other_grads_sum=-2.994e-09
  this: logprobs_from_logits_naive: logprob=-2.994e-09 label_grad=2.994e-09 other_grads_sum=-2.994e-09
  ```
  v2 gives the same numbers.
- **Memory** (CUDA, logits `[4, 1024, 32000]`, forward then backward):

  | | retained between fwd and bwd, `main` → this PR | fwd+bwd peak, `main` → this PR |
  |---|---|---|
  | v2 fp32 | 0 → 0 | 0.98 → 0.98 GiB |
  | v2 bf16 | 0.24 → 0 GiB | 0.49 → 0.49 GiB |
  | naive fp32 | 0.49 → 0 GiB | 1.46 → 0.98 GiB |
  | naive bf16 | 0.24 → 0 GiB | 0.73 → 0.98 GiB |

  naive bf16 now upcasts to fp32 inside the forward, so its peak rises. Nothing is kept between forward and backward for any path.
- `pre-commit run` on the changed files passes.

### API and Usage Example

No API changes. Results match `log_softmax` at ordinary margins, and differ from `main` only where `main` had rounded to 0. bf16 inputs are now computed in fp32 and cast back to bf16.

### Design & Code Changes

- New `_LabelLogprobs` `autograd.Function` in `verl/utils/torch_functional.py`:
  - **Forward:** gathers the label logit, then takes the logsumexp of a copy of the logits with the label set to `-inf`, in at least fp32. It saves the full `logsumexp(z) = logaddexp(logsumexp_{j != t}(z_j), z_t)` for backward. Rebuilding it as `z_t - logp_t` would give NaN for a `-inf` label.

+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from verl.utils.torch_functional import logprobs_from_logits_naive, logprobs_from_logits_v2
+
+LOGPROB_FNS = [logprobs_from_logits_naive, logprobs_from_logits_v2]
+
+
+def _fp64_logprobs_and_grad(logits: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """fp64 logprob -softplus(logsumexp_{j != label} - z_label) and its gradient onehot - softmax."""
+    logits = logits.double()
+    label_logits = logits.gather(-1, labels.unsqueeze(-1))
+    others = logits.scatter(-1, labels.unsqueeze(-1), -torch.inf)
+    nll = F.softplus(others.logsumexp(-1, keepdim=True) - label_logits)
+    grad = -torch.exp(others - label_logits - nll)
+    grad.scatter_(-1, labels.unsqueeze(-1), -torch.expm1(-nll))
+    return -nll.squeeze(-1), grad
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("logprobs_fn", LOGPROB_FNS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float64])
+def test_logprobs_match_log_softmax(logprobs_fn, dtype):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    logits = torch.randn(2, 5, 37, dtype=dtype, requires_grad=True)
+    labels = torch.randint(0, 37, (2, 5))
+    logprobs = logprobs_fn(logits, labels)
+    (grad,) = torch.autograd.grad(logprobs.sum(), logits)
+
+    reference_logits = logits.detach().float().requires_grad_(True)
+    reference = F.log_softmax(reference_logits, dim=-1).gather(-1, labels.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
+    reference.sum().backward()
+    assert logprobs.dtype == dtype and logprobs.shape == labels.shape
+    tol = {"rtol": 1.6e-2, "atol": 1e-2} if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else {"rtol": 1e-5, "atol": 1e-6}
+    torch.testing.assert_close(logprobs.float(), reference, **tol)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(grad.float(), reference_logits.grad, **tol)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("logprobs_fn", LOGPROB_FNS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "dtype,label_logits",

+        # Margins over the other logits of ~23 to ~73: log_softmax rounds the logprob and label gradient to 0
+        (torch.float32, [30.0, 50.0, 80.0]),
+        # Margins of ~6 to ~23 in bf16
+        (torch.bfloat16, [13.0, 17.0, 30.0]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_logprobs_confident_label(logprobs_fn, dtype, label_logits):
+    vocab = 1000
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    logits = (0.1 * torch.randn(1, 3, vocab, generator=generator)).to(dtype)
+    labels = torch.tensor([[3, 500, 997]])
+    logits[0, torch.arange(3), labels[0]] = torch.tensor(label_logits, dtype=dtype)
+    logits.requires_grad_(True)
+    logprobs = logprobs_fn(logits, labels)
+    (grad,) = torch.autograd.grad(logprobs.sum(), logits)
+
+    expected_logprobs, expected_grad = _fp64_logprobs_and_grad(logits.detach(), labels)
+    rtol = 1e-5 if dtype == torch.float32 else 1e-2
+    assert torch.all(logprobs < 0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(logprobs.double(), expected_logprobs, rtol=rtol, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(grad.double(), expected_grad, rtol=10 * rtol, atol=0)
+    # The label gradient balances the others
+    label_grad = grad.double().gather(-1, labels.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(grad.double().sum(-1) - label_grad, -label_grad, rtol=10 * rtol, atol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("logprobs_fn", LOGPROB_FNS)
+def test_logprobs_label_without_competitors_has_finite_grad(logprobs_fn):
+    logits = torch.tensor([[[2.0, -torch.inf, -torch.inf]]], requires_grad=True)
+    logprobs = logprobs_fn(logits, torch.tensor([[0]]))
+    (grad,) = torch.autograd.grad(logprobs.sum(), logits)
+    assert logprobs.item() == 0.0
+    assert torch.all(grad == 0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("logprobs_fn", LOGPROB_FNS)
+def test_logprobs_unlikely_label_grad(logprobs_fn):
+    # A -inf label and one far below the others: the gradient is still onehot - softmax, and zero when masked out
+    logits = torch.tensor([[[-torch.inf, 0.0, 1.0], [-1e8, 0.0, 1.0]]], requires_grad=True)
+    labels = torch.tensor([[0, 0]])
+    logprobs = logprobs_fn(logits, labels)
+    (grad,) = torch.autograd.grad(logprobs.sum(), logits)
+    expected_grad = F.one_hot(labels, 3).double() - torch.softmax(logits.detach().double(), dim=-1)
+    assert logprobs[0, 0] == -torch.inf
+    torch.testing.assert_close(grad.double(), expected_grad, rtol=1e-5, atol=0)
+
+    masked = torch.where(torch.zeros_like(labels, dtype=torch.bool), logprobs_fn(logits, labels), 0.0)
+    (grad,) = torch.autograd.grad(masked.sum(), logits)
+    assert torch.all(grad == 0)

+    """Compute ``log_softmax(logits)[label]`` as ``-softplus(logsumexp_{j != label}(logits) - logits[label])``.
+
+    Gathering from log_softmax rounds a confident label's log-probability, and its gradient, to exactly 0 once
+    its margin over the other logits passes ~16.6 in fp32, while the gradients of the other logits stay nonzero.
+    Excluding the label from the logsumexp keeps both accurate down to exp underflow. See Barron et al.,
+    "A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy", arXiv:2610.31642.
+
+    Computed in at least float32 and returned in the dtype of the logits. Only the input logits and per-label
+    values are saved for backward, which recomputes the softmax, so no logits-sized copy is kept between forward
+    and backward.
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, logits: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        compute_dtype = torch.promote_types(logits.dtype, torch.float32)
+        label_logits = gather_from_labels(logits, labels).to(compute_dtype)
+        other_logits = logits.to(compute_dtype, copy=True).scatter_(-1, labels.unsqueeze(-1), -torch.inf)
+        other_logsumexp = torch.logsumexp(other_logits, dim=-1)
+        label_logprobs = -F.softplus(other_logsumexp - label_logits)
+        # Backward needs the full logsumexp; rebuilt as label_logits - label_logprobs it is NaN for a -inf label
+        logsumexp = torch.logaddexp(other_logsumexp, label_logits)
+        ctx.save_for_backward(logits, labels, logsumexp, label_logprobs)
+        return label_logprobs.to(logits.dtype)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @once_differentiable
+    def backward(ctx, grad_output: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, None]:
+        logits, labels, logsumexp, label_logprobs = ctx.saved_tensors
+        grad_output = grad_output.to(label_logprobs.dtype)
+        # -p_j for the other logits, and 1 - p_label = -expm1(logp_label), which stays accurate as p_label -> 1
+        grad_logits = logits.to(label_logprobs.dtype, copy=True).sub_(logsumexp.unsqueeze(-1)).exp_()

+        label_grad = grad_output * -torch.expm1(label_logprobs)

+        return grad_logits.to(logits.dtype), None

+class _LabelLogprobs(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """Compute ``log_softmax(logits)[label]`` as ``-softplus(logsumexp_{j != label}(logits) - logits[label])``.
+
+    Gathering from log_softmax rounds a confident label's log-probability, and its gradient, to exactly 0 once
+    its margin over the other logits passes ~16.6 in fp32, while the gradients of the other logits stay nonzero.
+    Excluding the label from the logsumexp keeps both accurate down to exp underflow. See Barron et al.,
+    "A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy", arXiv:2610.31642.
+
+    Computed in at least float32 and returned in the dtype of the logits. Only the input logits and per-label
+    values are saved for backward, which recomputes the softmax, so no logits-sized copy is kept between forward
+    and backward.
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, logits: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        compute_dtype = torch.promote_types(logits.dtype, torch.float32)
+        label_logits = gather_from_labels(logits, labels).to(compute_dtype)
+        other_logits = logits.to(compute_dtype, copy=True).scatter_(-1, labels.unsqueeze(-1), -torch.inf)
+        other_logsumexp = torch.logsumexp(other_logits, dim=-1)
+        label_logprobs = -F.softplus(other_logsumexp - label_logits)
